content.text:
All three renders are done and verified.

**Files created** in the working folder:

| File | Size | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| `square.png` | 1080×1080 | Logo + event name top, portrait/name row, big title, date + pill button footer |
| `landscape.png` | 1920×1080 | Header band, two columns: title left, large circular portrait + name right |
| `story.png` | 1080×1920 | Fully centered vertical stack, extra-large portrait and title |
| `card.html` | — | Source template (`?v=square\|landscape\|story`) |

Design notes:
- **Font** loaded via `@font-face` from `Inter.ttf` (variable weights 100–900), with rendering gated on `document.fonts.ready` so no fallback-font flash got baked into the PNGs.
- **Portrait** is a true circle at every size (`border-radius:50%` + `object-fit:cover`, `object-position:50% 30%` to keep the face centred) with a violet ring.
- **Title** uses the full string, wraps naturally, and is colour-split (white lead-in, violet remainder) for hierarchy. An auto-fit script shrinks it only if it would overflow — it never triggered, so all three kept their intended sizes (70 / 78 / 84 px).
- **Overflow check**: a script walks every element and compares its bounding box against the card bounds plus checks `scrollHeight`/`scrollWidth`; it reported zero defects for all three sizes. The speaker name is pinned to one line in landscape (column widened to 560 px) to avoid the earlier "Okonkwo-/Lindqvist" break.
- Palette is exactly `#0F1226` background, white text, `#7C5CFF` accent, with a subtle violet radial glow and top gradient rule.
